## Outline

1.  Logistic regression — revisited
2.  Occupancy models

# Logistic regression — revisited

## Binary responses

Let $z_i$ denote presence/absence at location $i$, and $\psi_i$ = probability of occurrence:

$$z_i \sim  ext{Bernoulli}(\psi_i)$$

$$  ext{logit}(\psi_i) =  eta_0 +  eta_1    imes X_i$$

-   $ eta_0$: intercept — log-odds of occurrence when $x = 0$
-   $ eta_1$: slope — change in log-odds per unit increase in $x$

## Setup


::: {.cell}

```{.webr .cell-code}
rm(list = ls())
library(stats)
```
:::


## Simulate presence/absence data


::: {.cell}

```{.webr .cell-code}
set.seed(541)
n_site    <- 100
elevation <- rnorm(n_site, mean = 0, sd = 1)

# True parameters
beta0 <- 2
beta1 <- -2

# True occurrence probability
psi     <- plogis(beta0 + beta1 * elevation)
z_lion  <- rbinom(n_site, size = 1, prob = psi)

sim_data <- data.frame(z_lion, elevation)
head(sim_data)
```
:::


## Fit logistic regression


::: {.cell}

```{.webr .cell-code}
glm_1 <- stats::glm(z_lion ~ elevation,
                    family = binomial, data = sim_data)
coef(glm_1)
```
:::


::: callout-note
Compare with the true values: β₀ = 2, β₁ = −2
:::

## Predictions on response scale


::: {.cell}

```{.webr .cell-code}
new_data       <- data.frame(
  elevation = seq(min(elevation), max(elevation), length.out = 100)
)
prediction <- predict(glm_1, newdata = new_data,
                      type = "response", se.fit = TRUE)
new_data$fit <- prediction$fit
new_data$upr <- plogis(predict(glm_1, newdata = new_data, type = "link")$fit +
                       1.96 * prediction$se.fit)
new_data$lwr <- plogis(predict(glm_1, newdata = new_data, type = "link")$fit -
                       1.96 * prediction$se.fit)
```
:::


## Visualize logistic regression


::: {.cell}

```{.webr .cell-code}
plot(elevation, z_lion,
     xlab = "Elevation (standardized)",
     ylab = "Pr(Lion present)",
     pch  = ifelse(z_lion == 1, 16, 1), cex = 0.8)
lines(new_data$elevation, new_data$fit,
      lwd = 3, col = "royalblue")
lines(new_data$elevation, new_data$upr,
      lwd = 1, col = "royalblue", lty = 2)
lines(new_data$elevation, new_data$lwr,
      lwd = 1, col = "royalblue", lty = 2)
```
:::


## The detection problem

::: {.callout-important title="Key insight"}
**Probability of occurrence ≠ Probability of detection**

A species may be present but not detected. Failing to account for imperfect detection leads to underestimated occurrence.
:::

A simple logistic regression **conflates** the two processes.

# Occupancy models

## Hierarchical model structure

**State process** (ecological):

$$z_i \sim  ext{Bernoulli}(\psi_i), \qquad  ext{logit}(\psi_i) =  eta_0 +  eta_1 X_i$$

**Observation process** (conditional on state):

$$y_{ij} \sim   ext{Bernoulli}(z_i  imes p_{ij}), \qquad    ext{logit}(p_{ij}) = lpha_0 + lpha_1 C_{ij}$$

-   $z_i$ = true (partially observed) presence/absence at site $i$
-   $y_{ij}$ = observed detection at site $i$, visit $j$
-   $p_{ij}$ = detection probability given the species is present

## Simple occupancy: simulate data


::: {.cell}

```{.webr .cell-code}
set.seed(541)
psi      <- 0.5    # occurrence probability
p        <- 0.2    # detection probability
n_site   <- 20
n_visit  <- 4

# True state
z <- rbinom(n_site, size = 1, prob = psi)

# Observations
y <- matrix(NA, nrow = n_site, ncol = n_visit)
for (i in seq_len(n_site)) {
  y[i, ] <- rbinom(n_visit, size = 1, prob = z[i] * p)
}

sim_data <- data.frame(z = z, y = y)
sim_data
```
:::


## Naive occupancy


::: {.cell}

```{.webr .cell-code}
site_det <- rowSums(y)
table(site_det)

# Naive: proportion of sites where species was detected
naive_occ <- sum(site_det > 0) / n_site
cat("Naive occupancy:", round(naive_occ, 2),
    " (true:", psi, ")")
```
:::


## Occupancy model with covariates: simulate


::: {.cell}

```{.webr .cell-code}
set.seed(541)
n_site  <- 100
n_visit <- 6

# Occupancy covariate
elevation <- rnorm(n_site, mean = 0, sd = 0.5)

# Detection covariate (temperature)
temp  <- matrix(
  sample(c("Cold", "Hot"), n_site * n_visit, replace = TRUE),
  nrow = n_site, ncol = n_visit
)
tempD <- ifelse(temp == "Hot", 1, 0)

# True parameters
beta0 <- 3;  beta1 <- -1
alpha0 <- -2; alpha1 <- 2

psi_cov <- plogis(beta0 + beta1 * elevation)
p_cov   <- plogis(alpha0 + alpha1 * tempD)

lion_z <- rbinom(n_site, size = 1, psi_cov)
lion_y <- matrix(NA, n_site, n_visit)
for (i in seq_len(n_site)) {
  lion_y[i, ] <- rbinom(n_visit, size = 1, prob = lion_z[i] * p_cov[i, ])
}
```
:::


## Fit occupancy model (nimble)


::: {.cell}

```{.webr .cell-code}
library(nimble)
library(coda)

list_data <- list(
  y           = lion_y,
  n_site      = n_site,
  n_visit     = n_visit,
  elevation   = elevation,
  temperature = tempD
)

model_1 <- nimbleCode({
  for (i in 1:n_site) {
    z[i] ~ dbern(psi[i])
    logit(psi[i]) <- b0 + b_elevation * elevation[i]
    for (j in 1:n_visit) {
      y[i,j] ~ dbern(z[i] * p[i,j])
      logit(p[i,j]) <- a0 + a_temperature * temperature[i,j]
    }
  }
  mean_p   ~ dunif(0, 1)
  mean_psi ~ dunif(0, 1)
  a0       <- logit(mean_p)
  b0       <- logit(mean_psi)
  b_elevation   ~ dunif(-20, 20)
  a_temperature ~ dunif(-20, 20)
})

zst   <- apply(lion_y, 1, max)
inits <- list(
  z             = ifelse(zst == 1, 1, NA),
  mean_p        = runif(1),
  mean_psi      = runif(1),
  b_elevation   = runif(1),
  a_temperature = runif(1)
)
params <- c("a0", "b0", "a_temperature", "b_elevation")
ni <- 30000; nb <- 5000; nc <- 4; nt <- 1

out1 <- nimbleMCMC(
  code = model_1, constants = list_data,
  inits = inits, monitors = params,
  nburnin = nb, niter = ni, thin = nt, nchains = nc,
  samplesAsCodaMCMC = TRUE, summary = TRUE
)
```
:::


## Inspect results


::: {.cell}

```{.webr .cell-code}
out1$summary$all.chains
```
:::


::: callout-tip
Compare with true values: β₀ = 3, β₁ = −1, α₀ = −2, α₁ = 2
:::

## Traceplots


::: {.cell}

```{.webr .cell-code}
par(mfrow = c(2, 2))
coda::traceplot(out1$samples)
par(mfrow = c(1, 1))
```
:::


## Predict occupancy across elevations


::: {.cell}

```{.webr .cell-code}
b0_mean  <- out1$summary$all.chains["b0", "Mean"]
b1_mean  <- out1$summary$all.chains["b_elevation", "Mean"]

new_elev  <- seq(min(elevation), max(elevation), length.out = 100)
psi_pred  <- plogis(b0_mean + b1_mean * new_elev)

plot(new_elev, psi_pred, type = "l",
     lwd = 2, col = "royalblue",
     xlab = "Elevation (standardized)",
     ylab = expression(psi ~ "(Pr of lion presence)"))
```
:::


## Summary

::: {.callout-note title="Key takeaways"}
-   Logistic regression estimates occurrence probability but **assumes perfect detection**
-   Occupancy models **separate** state and observation processes
-   With repeated visits, we can jointly estimate $\psi$ (occurrence) and $p$ (detection)
-   Bayesian implementation in nimble provides full uncertainty quantification
:::

<script>
  // htmlwidgets need to know to resize themselves when slides are shown/hidden.
  // Fire the "slideenter" event (handled by htmlwidgets.js) when the current
  // slide changes (different for each slide format).
  (function () {
    // dispatch for htmlwidgets
    function fireSlideEnter() {
      const event = window.document.createEvent("Event");
      event.initEvent("slideenter", true, true);
      window.document.dispatchEvent(event);
    }

    function fireSlideChanged(previousSlide, currentSlide) {
      fireSlideEnter();

      // dispatch for shiny
      if (window.jQuery) {
        if (previousSlide) {
          window.jQuery(previousSlide).trigger("hidden");
        }
        if (currentSlide) {
          window.jQuery(currentSlide).trigger("shown");
        }
      }
    }

    // hookup for slidy
    if (window.w3c_slidy) {
      window.w3c_slidy.add_observer(function (slide_num) {
        // slide_num starts at position 1
        fireSlideChanged(null, w3c_slidy.slides[slide_num - 1]);
      });
    }

  })();
</script>
